extract_probe.label: english-g8-families
extract_probe.extract_md:
This lesson covers family relationships, physical descriptions of people, adverbs of manner, and adverbs of degree through reading about big families and listening to family descriptions.

## Concepts & terms
- Adverbs of manner describe how we do things [not in source].
- Adverbs of degree indicate the intensity or degree of an adjective, adverb, or verb [not in source].

## Rules & theorems
- We make many adverbs of manner by adding -ly to an adjective.
- For adjectives ending in -l, we double the l and add -y in the adverb form.
- For adjectives ending in a consonant + -y, we remove the -y and add -ily.
- Irregular adverbs include good changing to well, fast changing to fast, and hard changing to hard.

## Worked-example types
- Complete a family tree using a listening description of family members.
- Describe people using adjectives for appearance.
- Form adverbs of manner from given adjectives and use them correctly in sentences.
- Match adverbs of degree to their correct meanings and use them in sentences.
- Write a description of your own family using appropriate vocabulary and grammar.

## Key facts
- Adverbs of manner describe how actions are performed.
- Ella Blackstone is the oldest of eight children in a big family.
- Big families often require sharing bedrooms, toys, and parents' time, and moving quickly.

## Vocabulary & set phrases

## Source sentences & passages
- What’s it like to grow up in a big family?
- I am the oldest of eight children.
- Remembering the names, ages and birthdays of all your family members is really difficult.
- Being slow is not a good thing in a big family.
- Sharing is not always easy, but we are quite good at it, luckily.
- Life in a big family has its ups and downs, but I love it.

“Alpomish” dostoni o‘zbek xalq dostonchiligining cho‘qqisi va o‘zbek xalqining ma’naviy olami hamda ruhiyat dunyosini ko‘rsatuvchi ko‘zgudir.

## Key facts
- O‘zbek dostonlari ichida “Alpomish” dostoni Fozil Yo‘ldosh o‘g‘li ijrosida eng yuksak va mukammal nusxalardan biri sifatida tan olingan.
- Fozil Yo‘ldosh o‘g‘li 1872-yilda Jizzax viloyati Baxmal tumani Loyqa qishlog‘ida tug‘ilgan.
- “Alpomish” dostoni yaratilganining ming yilligi 1999-yilda keng bayram qilindi.
- Doston boshida Dobonbiydan Alpinbiy, Alpinbiydan Boybo‘ri va Boysari dunyoga kelgani aytiladi.
- Boybo‘rining o‘g‘li Hakimbek (Alpomish) va Boysarining qizi Oybarchin Shohimardon pir tomonidan beshikkerti qilib unashtirilgan.
- Hakimbek yetti yoshida Alpinbiy bobosidan qolgan o‘n to‘rt botmon bronza yoyni tortib, to‘qson alpning biri bo‘lib sanaga o‘tgan va Alpomish deb ot qo‘yilgan.
- Boysari akasi Boybo‘rining zakot talab qilishidan xafa bo‘lib, o‘n ming uyli qo‘ng‘irot elini boshlab Qalmoq yurtiga (Kashal eliga) ko‘chib ketgan.
- Qalmoq alplari Barchinoyga og‘iz solib kelganida, Barchinoy Ko‘kamanni chalqaramon qilib yerga qo‘yib, alplardan olti oy muhlat so‘ragan.
- Alpomish qirq chilton va Shohimardon pir homiyligida Qalmoq yurtiga safar qilib, Qorajon bilan do‘stlashgan va uni o‘ziga yordamchi qilgan.
- Alpomish poyga, yoy tortish va kurash shartlarini bajarib, Ko‘kaldoshni yenggan va Oybarchin bilan turmush qurib eliga qaytgan.
- Xalq dostonlari qahramonlik, jangnoma, romantik, tarixiy va kitobiy dostonlarga bo‘linadi.
- Xalq dostonlaridagi she’rlar asosan o‘n bir bo‘g‘inli barmoq vaznida bo‘lib, jang manzaralari va tezkor harakatlar yetti-sakkiz bo‘g‘inli she’rlar bilan ifodalanadi.
